note: Inquirer: kagawad of Bungued shot dead Monday morning (Oct 12) on the Bungued-Dalican road near the public market in Poblacion Dalican, Datu Odin Sinsuat.

Toll and place bear out (Inquirer, Philstar, GMA, SunStar: 1 soldier dead, 6 soldiers and a father and son wounded in Barangay Sabong, Lamitan, Oct 8); summary rewritten because it named the suspected group leader.
summary: Gunmen positioned on high ground fired on a military truck carrying troops of the Army's 45th Infantry Battalion at about 6:50 p.m. on October 8, 2026, along the highway in Barangay Sabong, Lamitan City, Basilan. 1 soldier died of a head wound early on October 9; 6 other soldiers and a father and his 10-year-old son passing in a pedicab were wounded. The military linked the attack to the October 5 Tipo-Tipo ambush and a September 29 law enforcement operation in Barangay Baimbing, Lamitan.

note: Place, day and toll bear out (BusinessWorld, Manila Times: 12 soldiers and a CAFGU member wounded in Sitio Bauno Dagao, Barangay Badja, Tipo-Tipo, Oct 5); summary rewritten because it named the suspect and his late wife.
summary: Gunmen fired on a 6-vehicle convoy of the Army's 45th Infantry Battalion at about 7:45 a.m. on Monday, October 5, 2026, in Sitio Bauno Dagao, Barangay Badja, Tipo-Tipo, Basilan, as it headed for brigade headquarters in Isabela City. 12 soldiers and a CAFGU militiaman were wounded, 3 of them critically with head wounds; early counts ranged from 6 to 11. The military saw it as retaliation for a September 29 law enforcement operation in Lamitan City.

note: Philstar: 2 Yakan men on a motorcycle killed in an ambush on the highway in Barangay Marang, Sumisip, at dusk Sunday Oct 4; summary said the town was unnamed.
title: 2 villagers killed in clan war ambush in Marang, Sumisip, Basilan
summary: 2 men riding a motorcycle were killed by gunmen positioned along the highway in Barangay Marang, Sumisip, Basilan, at about dusk on Sunday, October 4, 2026. Relatives blamed a rival clan and traded shots with its members afterward, with no one else hurt; police and Army troops separated the feuding groups.

note: Philstar: 2 merchants killed and a companion wounded when gunmen waylaid their tricycle on the highway in Barangay Pembalkan, Mamasapano, Thursday afternoon Sept 24; summary said the town was unnamed.
title: 2 merchants killed, companion hurt in ambush in Pembalkan, Mamasapano
summary: Gunmen ambushed 3 merchants riding a tricycle loaded with sound systems along a highway in Barangay Pembalkan, Mamasapano, Maguindanao del Sur, on the afternoon of Thursday, September 24, 2026. 2 were declared dead on arrival at a hospital and the third was wounded; the attackers fled on motorcycles.

note: Philstar and SunStar: 2 soldiers of the 7th IB died after an ambush in Barangay Ladia, Sultan Kudarat, at dusk Sept 23 (GMA's first report had them wounded); summary rewritten to drop the victims' names.
summary: 2 off-duty soldiers of the Army's 7th Infantry Battalion riding a motorcycle were followed and shot by 2 men on another motorcycle at about 6:10 p.m. on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, along the Davao-Cotabato National Highway in Barangay Ladia, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte. Both died about 2 hours later at the Cotabato Regional Medical Center; GMA first reported them wounded.

note: GMA (AFP): 7 armed men killed in a police-military operation serving a warrant in Barangay Balong, Tugunan, SGA, Sept 19; Tribune puts the start in Sitio Gawang, Manaulanan, as the summary already says.
Inquirer places the shooting at Central Pilot Elementary School on Sinsuat Avenue, Poblacion 6, Cotabato City; Rappler gives the latest toll of 1 dead and 3 hurt.
Malaya, DZRH and Tribune: 3 dead, 15 hurt in shooting at Datu Usman Mampen Elementary School, Barangay Bagua 2, Cotabato City, about 11:40 p.m. Sept 13.

Inquirer: the intended target was shot in the stomach and a passer-by hit in the leg in Sitio Riverside, Matibay, Lamitan, Friday night Sept 11; summary left out the second victim and named a private victim.
summary: 2 gunmen on a motorcycle opened fire at about 7:20 p.m. on Friday, September 11, 2026, in Sitio Riverside, Barangay Matibay, Lamitan City, Basilan, near the residence of parliamentary candidate Rima Hassan. Her son-in-law, a businessman, was shot in the stomach and a passer-by was hit in the leg by a stray bullet; police recovered 9mm cartridges and had not ruled out a political motive.

note: Newsline and Philstar: 2 brothers on a motorcycle shot dead at about 1 p.m. Monday Sept 7 in Barangay Campo, Paglat; summary said the town was unnamed.
title: 2 brothers shot dead in Campo, Paglat, Maguindanao del Sur during election gun ban
summary: 2 brothers riding a motorcycle were shot dead by 2 gunmen on another motorcycle at about 1 p.m. on Monday, September 7, 2026, in Barangay Campo, Paglat, Maguindanao del Sur, during the election gun ban. The gunmen fled toward General S.K. Pendatun; relatives suspected an old grudge.

note: Inquirer: man settling a loan shot dead in front of his wife at 8:15 a.m. Tuesday (Aug 25) in Barangay Kalanganan 2, Cotabato City; summary lacked place and detail.
title: Man shot dead in front of his wife in Kalanganan 2, Cotabato City
summary: A man who had gone with his wife to settle a debt with a lending firm was shot dead in front of her with a .45-caliber pistol at 8:15 a.m. on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, in Barangay Kalanganan 2, Cotabato City. The gunman fled on a motorcycle; the victim had survived an earlier gun attack in April.

note: Inquirer: solar panel installer shot dead by a motorcycle-riding gunman at 10:40 a.m. Tuesday (Aug 25) at a house on the national highway in Barangay Dalumangcob, Sultan Kudarat; summary said the town was unnamed.
title: Solar panel installer shot dead in Dalumangcob, Sultan Kudarat
summary: A 26-year-old solar panel installer was shot dead by 1 of 2 men riding a motorbike at 10:40 a.m. on Tuesday, August 25, 2026, while installing panels at a house on the national highway in Barangay Dalumangcob, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, during the election gun ban.

note: Inquirer: a non-uniformed PRO-BAR employee assigned to Sultan Kudarat police was shot dead from behind on the national highway in Barangay Dalumangcob at 8:10 a.m. Saturday Aug 22; summary said the town was unnamed.
title: Police employee shot dead on highway in Dalumangcob, Sultan Kudarat
summary: A non-uniformed employee of the Bangsamoro regional police, assigned to the Sultan Kudarat municipal police station, was shot from behind by 2 men on a motorbike while riding his own motorbike to work along the national highway in Barangay Dalumangcob, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, at 8:10 a.m. on Saturday, August 22, 2026. He was killed; the motive was undetermined.

note: Inquirer: couple ambushed at 10:55 a.m. Friday Aug 21 on the Pagalungan bridge, wife killed and husband seriously wounded; Philstar's '2 slain in Maguindanao ambush' is the Datu Saudi-Ampatuan attack, and the summary named private victims.
summary: Gunmen riding tandem on a motorbike ambushed a farming couple from Kidapawan City in their multicab at about 10:55 a.m. on Friday, August 21, 2026, on the Pagalungan bridge, the boundary between Pagalungan, Maguindanao del Sur, and Pikit, Cotabato. The wife was killed and the husband seriously wounded; the motive was unknown.

note: Inquirer: 2 women shot at 11:45 a.m. Friday Aug 21 at a roadside eatery in Barangay Semba, Datu Odin Sinsuat; the later Aug 22 Inquirer report (in the 2026-08-22 Sultan Kudarat dossier) says the 68-year-old died, so 1 dead and 1 hurt.
title: Woman killed, another hurt in shooting at Semba, Datu Odin Sinsuat
summary: A gunman on a motorbike shot a 47-year-old businesswoman sitting in front of a roadside eatery in Barangay Semba, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, at 11:45 a.m. on Friday, August 21, 2026; a stray bullet hit a 68-year-old woman inside. A later report said the older woman was killed and the businesswoman injured; police recovered .45-caliber shells.

note: GMA: 2 dead, 1 hurt when gunmen fired on a vehicle going from Datu Unsay to Cotabato City in Datu Saudi Ampatuan on Thursday Aug 20; Philstar (cited in the Pagalungan dossier) gives the spot as Sitio Panang, Barangay Salbu, on the Cotabato-Isulan Highway.
GMA and Philstar: couple trapped and killed in their stall when the Shariff Aguak public market in Barangay Poblacion burned shortly before midnight Aug 19.
Not a qualifying incident: every article (Inquirer, GMA, Philstar, Tribune, SunStar and others) says no one was hurt when gunmen fired on the chief minister's convoy in Datu Odin Sinsuat on Aug 15.
Inquirer: bank employee shot in the hip and arm at 1:37 p.m. Wednesday (Aug 12) while collecting loan payments in Barangay Macabiso, Sultan Mastura; he was in stable condition.
title: Bank employee wounded while collecting loans in Macabiso, Sultan Mastura
summary: A 40-year-old employee of a cooperative bank was shot twice, in the hip and arm, by the back rider of a motorcycle at 1:37 p.m. on Wednesday, August 12, 2026, while collecting loan payments in Barangay Macabiso, Sultan Mastura, Maguindanao del Norte. He was taken to a hospital in Sultan Kudarat and reported stable.

note: Inquirer: man on a motorbike shot dead at about 10 a.m. on Monday (Aug 3, the reporting date) in Sitio Tuka, Barangay Taviran, Datu Odin Sinsuat; summary said the town was unnamed.
title: Man shot dead in Taviran, Datu Odin Sinsuat during election gun ban
summary: A 49-year-old man from Kabuntalan was shot dead by gunmen on another motorbike while riding his motorbike at about 10 a.m. on Monday, August 3, 2026, in Sitio Tuka, Barangay Taviran, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, during the election gun ban. Police recovered 4 empty shells.

note: Inquirer: pandesal vendor shot by a man posing as a customer at 10 a.m. Monday Aug 17 on the national highway in Barangay Bulit, Datu Montawal; he died at a hospital in Kabacan.
title: Pandesal vendor shot dead in Bulit, Datu Montawal
summary: A 35-year-old mobile bread vendor was shot several times in the head and body by a man posing as a customer along the national highway in Barangay Bulit, Datu Montawal, Maguindanao del Sur, at 10 a.m. on Monday, August 17, 2026. He died at a hospital in Kabacan; the gunman fled on a motorbike.

note: GMA: motor banca from Pura to Nalkan capsized off Barangay Pura, Datu Blah Sinsuat, Wednesday July 29; PCG rescued 6, all discharged stable.
GMA: PCG rescued at least 62 aboard M/L Trisha Mae after engine trouble off Bongao on Monday July 27 and towed it to Bongao port.
GMA Regional TV and GMA Balitambayan: rope-pulled boat with 12 aboard capsized in Barangay Edcor, Buldon, Tuesday July 21; 1 man drowned.
The only source is an ABS-CBN Facebook video with no body text; its caption matches the record (2 houses, P600,000, Ngingir, Calanogas, July 19).

GMA and Philstar: DXMS radio technician shot by motorcycle-riding gunmen on the Cotabato-Davao highway in Barangay Limbo, Sultan Kudarat, Tuesday afternoon July 14, died at hospital; summary rewritten to drop the private victim's name.
summary: A 56-year-old senior technician of the Catholic-run radio station DXMS in Cotabato City was trailed and shot 3 times by gunmen on a motorcycle at about 3:40 p.m. on Tuesday, July 14, 2026, along the Cotabato-Davao National Highway in Barangay Limbo, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, while riding to work. He died at a hospital; the attackers fled toward Cotabato City and the motive was undetermined.

note: GMA (July 13-14): 3 shootings in Cotabato City left 4 dead and 5 hurt, with police citing personal grudges; the summary's 'clan feuds spilling in from neighboring towns' is not in any loaded article.
summary: 3 shootings in Cotabato City on July 11-12, 2026 left 4 dead and 5 wounded: 2 men were shot dead in Barangay Rosary Heights 11 at about 3 a.m. on Saturday, July 11, and women passing on a motorcycle were hit; a civil engineer was killed and his 16-year-old son wounded in Rosary Heights 10 at about 11:20 a.m.; and a tricycle driver was killed and his young passenger and an off-duty police corporal, the intended target, wounded in Poblacion 5 at about 10:55 a.m. on Sunday, July 12. Police pointed to personal grudges and deployed extra quick reaction teams.

note: GMA, SunStar and Philstar give the Ngingir landslide at 2:30 a.m. on 10 July with 5 dead, 2 hurt, 6 missing; Inquirer later reports 7 dead, 4 missing, 2 injured and a state of calamity on 11 July.
Inquirer and GMA Regional TV put the ambush of four Malabang fire personnel in Barangay Bubongaranao, Calanogas, at about 7:30 p.m. on Wednesday 8 July, with 1 killed and 1 wounded.
The Manila Times post (via LinkedIn) reports aid to 30 fire-stricken households in Malabang on a Tuesday and gives no date for the fire.
GMA Regional TV reports a 38-year-old MILF-BIAF member from Mamasapano shot dead in the head in Barangay Poblacion 8, Cotabato City; it gives no date for the shooting.
Inquirer, Philstar and Tribune bear out the 27 June Barangay Lamin, Malabang ambush (2 dead, driver wounded); the summary is rewritten only to drop the names of private victims.
summary: At least 10 armed men ambushed a white Toyota Hilux pickup carrying soldiers and CAFGU militiamen back from a security operation as it passed Barangay Lamin, Malabang, Lanao del Sur, on the afternoon of Saturday, June 27, 2026, and also fired on a payong-payong motorcycle-for-hire trailing it. An Army corporal was killed, a 23-year-old volunteer teacher riding the payong-payong home died of a gunshot to the back of the head, and the pickup's civilian driver was wounded. Investigators recovered 7.62mm and 5.56mm casings and a rifle grenade; the Bangsamoro education ministry condemned the attack.

note: Tribune, DZRH and Inquirer confirm the officer shot dead in a mosque in Barangay Uyaan Proper, Madamba, at about 7:42 p.m. on 20 June; the summary is rewritten only to drop the victim's name.
summary: An off-duty police chief master sergeant of the Madamba Municipal Police Station was shot in the head and body by a man who approached from behind while he performed the isha evening prayer inside a mosque in Barangay Uyaan Proper, Madamba, Lanao del Sur, at about 7:42 p.m. on Saturday, June 20, 2026. He died on the spot and the gunman fled. PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. ordered a border-to-border manhunt, and police feared the killing could start a clan feud.

note: SunStar confirms the 11 a.m. 16 June killing in Baungis, Lantawan, Basilan; the summary is rewritten only to drop the victim's name.
summary: A 36-year-old man listed as Basilan's third most wanted person, facing two counts of murder and one of frustrated murder, was shot dead at about 11 a.m. on Tuesday, June 16, 2026, in Barangay Baungis, Lantawan, Basilan, when three men armed with 5.56mm rifles emerged from nearby bushes and opened fire while he was bathing. He died on the spot of multiple gunshot wounds; police were eyeing a personal grudge as the motive.

note: Both Philstar reports confirm the MILF 128th Base Command chief shot dead in his house in Barangay Tuayan Mother, Datu Hoffer, on the night of Friday 12 June; the summary is rewritten only to drop the victim's name.
summary: The chief of the MILF's 128th Base Command was shot several times by unidentified armed men who barged into his house in Barangay Tuayan Mother, Datu Hoffer Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur, on Friday night, June 12, 2026, as he prepared to sleep; he died of multiple gunshot wounds. Investigators had yet to determine whether the killing was tied to earlier attacks in the village that left more than 10 people dead.

note: MSSD reports the fire at about 5 p.m. on 7 June near the Matling roundball, Malabang: 21 structures totally and 1 partly damaged, 38 households affected and no casualties.
Both Philstar reports confirm 2 traffic enforcers shot dead in Barangay Campo Muslim, Malabang, on Thursday 4 June; the summary is rewritten only to drop the victims' names.
summary: Two municipal traffic enforcers on duty along a thoroughfare in Barangay Campo Muslim, Malabang, Lanao del Sur, were shot repeatedly with .45 and 9mm pistols by motorcycle-riding gunmen on Thursday, June 4, 2026. Both were declared dead on arrival at the Doctor Serapio Montañer Hospital. Police and local leaders believed the killings were related to their strict enforcement of traffic ordinances.

note: GMA and Philstar give the victim's age as 56, say he was shot riding home by motorcycle with his wife near the Fort Pikit barangay hall, and Philstar (23 May) says his wife was injured with bruises.
summary: A 56-year-old radio news reporter and disc jockey, also a member of the Fort Pikit barangay lupon, was shot in the head by motorcycle-riding gunmen near the barangay hall of Fort Pikit, Malidegao, in BARMM's Special Geographic Area, at about 7 p.m. on Thursday, May 21, 2026, as he and his wife rode home on a motorcycle. He was declared dead on arrival at the Cruzado Medical Hospital; his wife suffered bruises when the motorcycle fell. Police were looking at both his media work and his barangay role as possible motives.

note: GMA reports the lending collector shot by two motorcycle-riding men in Barangay Sarmiento, Parang, on the morning of Thursday 14 May, and declared dead on arrival.

Inquirer confirms 1 SAF corporal killed and 4 police wounded in Barangay Catogonan, Buadiposo-Buntong, at about 11 a.m. on Monday 4 May; the summary is rewritten to drop the suspect's and victims' names.
summary: A police team serving an arrest warrant for murder and attempted murder was fired on, reportedly with a sniper rifle, at about 11 a.m. on Monday, May 4, 2026, in Barangay Catogonan, Buadiposo-Buntong, Lanao del Sur. A Special Action Force corporal was killed and four other officers, three of them from the SAF, were wounded and taken to Marawi City in stable condition. The suspect escaped, and reinforcements with light armored vehicles were sent in.

note: Inquirer, GMA and DZRH confirm 1 dead and 3 wounded at a motorcycle shop in Poblacion 1, Shariff Aguak, at 12:18 p.m. on 30 April; Inquirer and GMA say two riding-in-tandem men (backrider shooting), and the summary drops the private victims' names.
summary: Two men riding in tandem on a motorcycle slowed in front of a motorcycle parts and repair shop in Barangay Poblacion 1, Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur, at 12:18 p.m. on Thursday, April 30, 2026, and the backrider opened fire with a 9mm pistol on four mechanics. One was declared dead on arrival at a hospital and three were wounded. Police recovered 14 empty 9mm casings, released CCTV footage and launched a manhunt for the gunmen, who fled toward the town roundabout.

note: Philstar names the town and barangay: the 2 men were ambushed in Barangay Bagoinged, Datu Odin Sinsuat, on Sunday 26 April, so the summary saying no town was named is wrong.
summary: Two Moro men from Barangay Tinonggos, known for supporting joint peacekeeping work of barangay officials and the police, were shot dead by gunmen while riding a green multicab in Barangay Bagoinged, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, on Sunday, April 26, 2026. The attackers escaped before police and barangay officials reached the scene.

note: Both Philstar reports (18 April) give 5 children drowned on Thursday 16 April in a pond in Barangay Panoroganan, Marawi, with one 8-year-old rescued; the summary already records the Inquirer's Kilala/15 April version.
Philstar says gunmen strafed the Tamontaka 4 barangay hall before dawn Tuesday, damaging the building, with no one killed or wounded, so it is not a qualifying shooting.

Inquirer and GMA confirm the barangay chairman and driver wounded in Sitio Bagyang, Barangay Malangit, Pandag, at 8:30 a.m. on 30 March; the summary drops the private driver's name, and Inquirer says the gunmen overtook the vehicle and the driver was seriously injured.
summary: Hadji Mansor Mangelen, chairman of Barangay Damalusay in Paglat, and his driver were wounded when motorcycle-riding gunmen overtook their black Toyota Innova and fired at the driver's side in Sitio Bagyang, Barangay Malangit, Pandag, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 8:30 a.m. on Monday, March 30, 2026, as they came from Buluan. The chairman was slightly injured and the driver seriously hurt; both were taken to Buluan District Hospital. The motive was unknown.

note: Inquirer, SunStar, GMA and Philstar confirm 5 police dead and 3 wounded in the 9:10 p.m. 28 March blast-and-gunfire ambush in Barangay Mother Poblacion, Shariff Aguak; later Inquirer, GMA and SunStar reports cover the April charges, 3 suspects killed on 26 April and arrests on 6 June and 21 July.

Inquirer and SunStar confirm a police corporal and civilian companion killed in Barangay Paglamatan, Saguiaran, before dawn on 28 March (Inquirer: about 1:45 a.m., two motorcycle-riding gunmen); the summary drops the victim's name.
summary: A 42-year-old police corporal of the PRO-BAR and a civilian companion from Bukidnon were shot dead by two motorcycle-riding gunmen with a .45-caliber pistol as they rode a gray Toyota Innova on a highway in Barangay Paglamatan, Saguiaran, Lanao del Sur, at about 1:45 a.m. on Saturday, March 28, 2026, hours before the ambush that killed five police officers in Shariff Aguak. Police reviewed CCTV footage, and PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. ordered a manhunt.

note: GMA Balitambayan reports the Grade 12 student hit on a pedestrian lane in Cotabato City on Monday 23 March by an overtaking motorcycle whose rider later surrendered; no barangay is named.
Philstar names the place, Barangay Punud, Calanogas, on the Secretary Narciso Ramos Highway, on Thursday 19 March, so the summary saying no town was named is wrong.
summary: A 59-year-old Maranao man from Malabang, known for supporting the joint peace and security programs of local officials and the police, was shot dead with pistols while driving his Toyota Revo along the Secretary Narciso Ramos Highway in Barangay Punud, Calanogas, Lanao del Sur, in a daytime ambush on Thursday, March 19, 2026. The gunmen escaped, and police launched a manhunt.

note: Inquirer and GMA put the 3 March ambush in Barangay Pagagawan of Datu Montawal town, not a town called Pagagawan, with 2 dead on arrival at the USM Hospital in Kabacan; the summary drops the private victims' names.
title: Retired police officer and companion killed in ambush in Datu Montawal
summary: A retired police officer who once headed the Pikit police and a companion were shot dead while travelling toward Pikit, Cotabato, when gunmen fired on their pickup truck on the national highway in Barangay Pagagawan, Datu Montawal, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 2:30 p.m. on Tuesday, March 3, 2026. Both were declared dead on arrival at the University of Southern Mindanao Hospital in Kabacan; police were investigating the motive.

note: The only source is a PNP Facebook post with no text loaded.
Inquirer names the town, Paglat, and the day: the councilor was shot dead in front of his home in Barangay Poblacion on a Wednesday, which is 18 March 2026 given the article date.
title: Town councilor shot dead in Paglat, Maguindanao del Sur
summary: Samon Kitalok, a municipal councilor of Paglat, Maguindanao del Sur, was shot dead at close range in front of his home in Barangay Poblacion, Paglat, on Wednesday, March 18, 2026, by one of two men on a motorbike who had briefly talked with him. Police found six empty pistol shells, and the provincial police director ordered a manhunt.

note: MSSD says 7 fire-affected families in Wao were identified and given aid on 17 February; it does not say the fire happened that day.
summary: Seven families in Wao, Lanao del Sur, affected by a fire were identified and given MSSD-BARMM welfare assistance on 17 February 2026. The report did not give the date of the fire, the barangay, the cause or any casualties.

note: GMA Regional TV reports the fire past 10 p.m. on 17 February in Barangay Rosary Heights, Cotabato City: about 7 houses razed, 20 families displaced, no one hurt, and a candle suspected.

Inquirer, GMA and SunStar confirm 1 killed and 2 wounded at about 11 a.m. on 17 February between Sitio Panang, Kabengi, and Salbu, Datu Saudi Ampatuan; GMA says the wounded went to the Maguindanao Provincial Hospital, and the summary drops the private victims' names.
summary: A nephew of Shariff Aguak Mayor Akmad Mitra Ampatuan Sr. was killed and the mayor's younger brother and a companion were wounded when gunmen in a white minivan without plates tailed their Nissan Livina and opened fire on the national highway between Sitio Panang, Barangay Kabengi, and Barangay Salbu, Datu Saudi Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 11 a.m. on Tuesday, February 17, 2026. The driver reached Barangay Meta, Datu Unsay, near an Army checkpoint, and the nephew was declared dead on arrival at hospital. The PNP linked the attack to the January 25 ambush of the mayor.

note: The only article (Manila Bulletin) was blocked by a bot check; no text to verify.
MSSD release says 2 families lost their homes to a fire in Barangays Dilausan Poblacion and Balintao, Maguing, and got aid on 12 February.
Philstar, Inquirer, GMA, SunStar and BARMM all put the fire at 10:09 p.m. on 3 February in Lamion, Bongao, about 1,000 houses razed, no deaths.
Inquirer and Philstar place the killing in Barangay Bandara-Ingud, Pagayawan at about 7 a.m. on Friday 30 January; the old summary said no town was named.
title: Off-duty Army corporal shot dead in Bandara-Ingud, Pagayawan, Lanao del Sur
summary: An off-duty corporal of the Army's 55th Infantry Battalion was shot dead with assault rifles while riding his motorcycle toward Ganassi at Barangay Bandara-Ingud, Pagayawan, Lanao del Sur, at about 7 a.m. on Friday, 30 January 2026. He sustained around 15 gunshot wounds; the gunmen escaped with his belongings.

note: SunStar and Daily Tribune confirm 2 soldiers wounded by a lone gunman at a store 200 m from their camp in Tipo-Tipo on 26 January; summary rewritten to drop the soldiers' names and title given the town.
title: Lone gunman wounds 2 soldiers near their camp in Tipo-Tipo, Basilan
summary: Two soldiers of the Army's 45th Infantry Battalion were shot and wounded by a lone gunman while buying supplies at a community store about 200 meters from their camp in Tipo-Tipo, Basilan, at 5:28 p.m. on Monday, 26 January 2026. Two .45-caliber shells were recovered; the 45IB pursued the gunman into the mountains and the PNP joined the manhunt on 28 January.

note: Inquirer's later House-hearing report (2273407) gives the PCG toll as 66 dead, 13 missing, 293 survivors; DZRH says the full underwater search ended Monday 23 February.
title: Ferry MV Trisha Kerstin 3 sinks off Baluk-Baluk Island, Basilan; 66 dead, 13 missing
summary: The Aleson Shipping ro-ro ferry MV Trisha Kerstin 3, sailing from Zamboanga City to Jolo with 332 passengers and 27 crew on its manifest, sank about 2.75 nautical miles northeast of Baluk-Baluk Island, Hadji Muhtamad, Basilan at about 1:50 a.m. on Monday, 26 January 2026. PCG divers searched the wreck until 23 February, and the PCG later told a House inquiry that 66 died, 13 remain missing and 293 survived; Marina fined Aleson P3 million and kept it suspended.

note: Philstar, GMA, Rappler and SunStar confirm the RPG and gunfire ambush at about 6:30 a.m. on 25 January in Poblacion, Shariff Aguak, mayor unhurt and 2 escorts wounded (Rappler alone adds a wounded civilian).

Philstar, Rappler and IBTimes confirm 3 ambush suspects killed in a gunfight in Barangay Meta, Datu Unsay; later Inquirer and Philstar reports say a fourth escaped, so the 'four killed' line is outdated, and suspects' names are removed.
summary: Hours after the ambush on Shariff Aguak Mayor Akmad Ampatuan's convoy on Sunday, 25 January 2026, pursuing police, soldiers and community watchmen cornered the attackers in Barangay Meta, Datu Unsay, Maguindanao del Sur; the suspects opened fire and three were killed in the brief gunfight. A rocket launcher and high-powered firearms were recovered; a fourth suspect, the driver, escaped and was being hunted.

note: Philstar and Baird Maritime confirm M/L Sitti Nur overturned between Simunul and Bongao on Monday 19 January and all 12 aboard were rescued.
GMA and Daily Tribune confirm the Navy rescued 30 from the rudderless M/L Nurdia about 46 nautical miles east of Taganak on the night of 16 January.
Philstar names the place: Sitio Daubab, Barangay Tamontaka, Datu Odin Sinsuat, on Thursday night 15 January.
title: Barangay watchman shot dead in ambush in Tamontaka, Datu Odin Sinsuat
summary: A Barangay Peacekeeping Action Team member was ambushed and killed while driving his tricycle home along an unlit road in Sitio Daubab, Barangay Tamontaka, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, on Thursday night, 15 January 2026. He died instantly from multiple bullet wounds; the gunmen escaped before responders arrived.

note: Inquirer and Philstar confirm the ambush in Barangay Kapinpilan, Ampatuan, past 8 p.m. on 12 January; summary rewritten without the victims' names and title given the place.
title: MILF commander and aide killed in ambush in Kapinpilan, Ampatuan
summary: A senior commander of the MILF's 118th Base Command, 46, and his 44-year-old aide, also an MILF member, were killed when gunmen positioned along a dirt road fired on their minivan in Barangay Kapinpilan, Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur, past 8 p.m. on Monday, 12 January 2026. Both were dead on arrival at hospital; police and the Army's 601st Infantry Brigade launched a manhunt.

note: DZRH and GMA place the hostage-taking in Sabala Manao Proper, Marawi early on 21 December with the man shot dead and the girl injured; Philstar alone says Barangay Dansalan.
GMA and SunStar confirm the 6 a.m. 16 December fire in Matibay, Lamitan, 3 houses razed and a resident and a firefighter hurt; summary rewritten to drop the firefighter's name.
summary: A second-alarm fire that broke out at about 6 a.m. on 16 December 2025 at a gasoline dealer's house in Barangay Matibay, Lamitan City, razed at least 3 houses and affected 2 others before firefighters put it out after nearly two hours. The 57-year-old house owner and a firefighter were burned; damage was estimated at about P750,000. Investigators suspect faulty wiring, and stored LPG and oxygen tanks worsened the blaze.

note: Inquirer says both Sultan sa Barongis councilors, Montasir Dimalido and Abdulmanap Biang, were hurt and are recuperating in hospital, not one.
title: Aide killed, 2 councilors wounded in ambush in Tuka, Mamasapano
summary: Gunmen ambushed a vehicle carrying Sultan sa Barongis municipal councilors Montasir Dimalido and Abdulmanap Biang and a 25-year-old companion in front of the barangay hall of Barangay Tuka, Mamasapano, Maguindanao del Sur, at about 3:45 p.m. on Thursday, 4 December 2025, as they drove home from Cotabato City. The companion was killed and both councilors were wounded; police and soldiers mounted follow-up operations.

note: MSSD release confirms 4 families lost their homes in a fire in Barangay Malungun, Maguing on 7 November 2025.
MSSD release confirms 5 fire-affected families from Pilintangan, Amoyong, Gata and the Cebuana Group, Wao, got aid and P40,000 to rebuild on 13 November 2025.
Inquirer says no casualties or injuries were reported, and the BFP declared the fire out at 3:45 p.m.
summary: A fire that broke out at about 3 p.m. on Saturday, 25 October 2025 destroyed part of the hilltop barracks of the Philippine Army's 103rd Infantry (Haribon) Brigade at Kampo Ranao, Marawi City, before soldiers and BFP firefighters contained it; it was declared out at 3:45 p.m. The brigade blamed faulty electrical wiring, and no casualties or injuries were reported.

note: BARMM release confirms the 21 October fire in Rosary Heights IV, Cotabato City: 3 houses totally and 1 partially damaged, 11 families aided.

GMA and Inquirer confirm the 10:30 a.m. 21 October killing at the Malinis bus terminal, Lamitan, and 2 arrests; summary rewritten to drop suspects' names and the unsupported details (age, sachet count).
title: Tipo-Tipo village councilman shot dead at Lamitan bus terminal; 2 suspects arrested
summary: Nadzri Tarahin, an Islamic teacher and councilman of Barangay Baguindan, Tipo-Tipo, was shot several times while waiting at the bus terminal in Barangay Malinis, Lamitan City, Basilan, at about 10:30 a.m. on Tuesday, 21 October 2025, and was declared dead on arrival at hospital. A hot pursuit led to the arrest of two suspects with two .45-caliber pistols, a motorcycle and suspected shabu; a third was at large, and police eyed revenge as the motive.

note: Philstar says the gunmen attacked the family's tricycle on a highway in Barangay Kapinpilan and also wounded the councilor's daughter.
title: MNLF commander and son killed, daughter wounded in ambush in Kapinpilan, Ampatuan
summary: Abusama Agao, a longtime MNLF commander and barangay councilor of Matagabong, Ampatuan, and his son, a volunteer watchman, were killed and his daughter wounded when gunmen ambushed their tricycle along a highway in Barangay Kapinpilan, Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur, on Monday, 13 October 2025. The attackers escaped on motorcycles; police and the MNLF were working to identify them.

note: SunStar confirms FB Mona sank in strong winds between Tamok Island, Basilan and Duay Bulod Island, Sulu, with all 20 crew rescued around 7:25 a.m. on 6 October; 7:25 was the rescue time, and the skipper's name is removed.
summary: The fishing boat FB Mona sank after being battered by strong winds and big waves while fishing in waters between Tamok Island, Basilan, and Duay Bulod Island, Sulu, on Monday, 6 October 2025. Basilan maritime police, the Coast Guard's Maluso sub-station and local fishermen rescued all 20 crew unhurt at around 7:25 a.m. and towed the boat to Teheem Island, Maluso.

note: Inquirer places the killing in front of her gasoline station in Barangay Kamasi, Ampatuan, on Saturday afternoon 27 September.
title: Businesswoman shot dead at her gas station in Kamasi, Ampatuan
summary: A businesswoman was shot several times at close range by one of two men riding tandem on a motorcycle while she inspected her newly built gasoline station on the national highway in Barangay Kamasi, Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur, on Saturday afternoon, 27 September 2025. The gunmen fled.

note: Inquirer and Philstar confirm a man, his wife and 16-year-old daughter killed and an 11-year-old wounded in a tricycle ambush in Nalinan, Sultan Kudarat on 1 September; neither gives the 3 p.m. time or the two motorcycle gunmen.
title: Family of 3 killed, boy wounded in ambush in Nalinan, Sultan Kudarat
summary: A man, his wife and their 16-year-old daughter were killed and an 11-year-old boy wounded when unidentified gunmen ambushed the family's tricycle on a village road in Barangay Nalinan, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, on Monday, 1 September 2025. The father died on the spot and his wife and daughter in hospital; the attackers and motive were unknown.

note: Inquirer names Barangay Bagoinged, Datu Odin Sinsuat, at 12:30 p.m. on 1 September: a father and son killed in a two-hour firefight with police and Army during a buy-bust.
title: Father and son killed in buy-bust firefight in Bagoinged, Datu Odin Sinsuat
summary: A 48-year-old farmer and his 19-year-old son were killed in a two-hour firefight with police and Army troops during a buy-bust in Barangay Bagoinged, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, from about 12:30 p.m. on Monday, 1 September 2025, after an armed group reinforced the suspects. Police recovered two rifles and drugs reportedly worth P1.6 million; another son escaped.

note: MSSD says fires in September left 7 families in Moriatao Bae Labay and 1 in Ampuan Lacadun homeless; the Dalog Balut windstorm hurt nobody and is a separate, non-qualifying event.
title: September fires in Moriatao Bae Labay and Ampuan Lacadun, Masiu leave 8 families homeless
summary: Fires in September 2025 destroyed the homes of 7 families in Barangay Moriatao Bae Labay and 1 family in Barangay Ampuan Lacadun, Masiu, Lanao del Sur. MSSD-BARMM gave the families relief on 13 October 2025; casualties were not reported.

note: SunStar confirms the 11:11 a.m. 22 August capsizing between Mantabuan and Latuan islands with 5 rescued and 1 stung by a stingray; summary rewritten to drop the skipper's name.
summary: A motorboat carrying 5 people to Poblacion, Sapa-Sapa, Tawi-Tawi for an Islamic ceremony at the MSU covered court was battered by huge waves from the southwest monsoon and capsized at about 11:11 a.m. on Friday, 22 August 2025 between the islands of Mantabuan and Latuan. All 5 were rescued by about noon, the Sapa-Sapa MDRRMO said; one, stung by a stingray, was given first aid and taken to Tuan Ligaddung Lipae Memorial Hospital.

note: MSSD says 6 families were affected by a fire in Barangay Daguan, Kapatagan, on August 18, 2025 (the date may be the relief date; the wording is ambiguous).
GMA, Rappler, Davao Today, DZRH and Inquirer confirm the August 4 killing in Barangay Narra, Balabagan; summary rewritten to drop the private victim's and suspect's names.
summary: A 34-year-old teacher at Balabagan Trade School was shot dead with a .45-caliber pistol at about 8 a.m. on August 4, 2025, as he walked to the school in Barangay Narra, Balabagan, Lanao del Sur. Police said the gunman, a 20-year-old Grade 11 student angered over a failing or incomplete grade, fled to Marogong and later surrendered with the help of his brother, a police officer. Police and soldiers were then posted at the school.

note: MSSD says a fire in Barangay Kapai Proper affected 9 families and damaged 3 houses, with relief given on August 6, 2025.
BARMM BIO report covers the three Masiu household fires, the cooking fire in Lumbac Caramian and the second-degree burns in Langco Dimapatoy, as recorded.

Philstar (July 27) and Inquirer confirm the July 25 ambush in Barangay Romongaob, South Upi, 1 dead and 1 wounded; Inquirer 1984575 is about a different killing (a Barangay Bongo councilman); summary drops the private victims' names.
summary: A Teduray tribal chieftain, a former councilman of Barangay Pilar, was killed and his wife, a teacher, was wounded when armed men fired on their red multicab on a secluded stretch of highway in Sitio Lenan, Barangay Romongaob, South Upi, Maguindanao del Sur, on Friday, July 25, 2025, as they drove home to Barangay Pilar. The gunmen fled on motorcycles; South Upi and provincial police were working to identify them.

note: SunStar says all 18 aboard a motorboat that capsized in strong winds off Maluso were rescued at about 10 a.m. on July 12, 2025, with no casualties or missing.
MSSD says a fire in Barangays Tiongcop and Calumbog, Malabang, affected 227 families (18 houses totally and 15 partly damaged); relief was given July 8, 2025.
Lanao del Sur provincial government says a 5:48 a.m. fire in Barangay Marawi Poblacion hit one establishment and was out by 6:45 a.m., with no casualties; the article itself gives no date.
Daily Tribune says the sea ambush near Sangbay Island Big on the way to Hadji Muhtamad at about 2 a.m. on May 12 killed 3 and injured 4; TV5 and MB were blocked.
Inquirer places the April 13 ambush in Barangay Brar, Datu Anggal Midtimbang, not Buluan; the candidate was bruised and his driver seriously hurt.
title: Candidate and driver hurt in Datu Anggal Midtimbang ambush
summary: Muhammad Utti Omar, alias Datu Baba, a candidate for board member of Maguindanao del Sur's first district, was bruised and his driver seriously wounded when about three gunmen with long firearms fired on their vehicle in Barangay Brar, Datu Anggal Midtimbang, at about 3 p.m. on Sunday, April 13, 2025; the driver kept driving to a police checkpoint. Responding police briefly exchanged fire with the attackers, who escaped. The candidate said the attack was politically motivated, and the Comelec placed nearby Buluan under its control amid election violence.

note: Philstar (April 12 and 14) and Inquirer put the ambush on Friday, April 11, 2025, in Barangay Dugaa, Tuburan, 2 soldiers killed and 1 wounded; summary drops the soldiers' names.
title: 2 Army intelligence soldiers killed, 1 wounded in Tuburan, Basilan ambush
summary: Two intelligence soldiers of the Army's 18th Infantry Battalion were killed and a third wounded when gunmen with M16 rifles ambushed them as they rode two motorcycles from the Dugaa patrol base to their company post at about 4:25 p.m. on Friday, April 11, 2025, in Barangay Dugaa, Tuburan, Basilan. The attackers took the soldiers' firearms and fled; the wounded soldier was treated in Lamitan City and airlifted to Zamboanga City.

note: Rappler, GMA, Inquirer and SunStar confirm the March 26 ambush in Barangay Makir that killed the town election officer and her husband; summary drops the husband's name (not an official).
summary: Datu Odin Sinsuat election officer Atty. Bai Maceda Lidasan Abo and her husband, who was driving, were shot by unidentified gunmen on the Cotabato-Shariff Aguak road in Barangay Makir, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, at about 8:20 a.m. on Wednesday, March 26, 2025. Her husband was dead on arrival at the Datu Odin Sinsuat District Hospital; she died later at the Cotabato Regional Medical Center. Police recovered ten 5.56 mm cartridge cases, and the Comelec chairman moved to place the town under Comelec control.

note: MSSD says 12 families were affected by a March 19, 2025 fire in Barangay Bacong, Marantao, and received aid on March 20.
Davao Today and Philstar confirm the March 17 ambush in Barangay Awang, 1 dead and 1 critically wounded; summary drops the private victims' names.
summary: A 27-year-old lawyer and certified public accountant was killed and her fiance, also a lawyer, was critically wounded when two gunmen on a motorcycle fired on their vehicle on the highway in Barangay Awang, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, at about 3:15 p.m. on Monday, March 17, 2025. She was declared dead on arrival at the hospital; the couple were to wed in April. The IBP Cotabato chapter condemned the attack.

note: SunStar, GMA and Inquirer confirm M/L Bangsata sank off Turtle Islands on March 16, 2025, with 26 picked up by the Navy and 6 by a Malaysian vessel.
Philstar dates the Buluan ambush to Friday, March 21, 2025, on the highway through the town centre; GMA confirms 1 dead and 1 wounded.
title: Company manager killed, wife wounded in Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur ambush
summary: A 70-year-old manager of an agri-machinery company in Buluan was killed and his 66-year-old wife wounded when motorcycle-riding gunmen fired on the pickup he was driving on the national highway through the town centre of Buluan, Maguindanao del Sur, on Friday, March 21, 2025. The pickup veered off the road into a swamp; he was declared dead on arrival and his wife was hospitalised. The couple were residents of Mlang, Cotabato.

note: Philstar names the town and barangay: the campaign manager was shot dead in Barangay Himba, Tandubas, on Friday, February 28, 2025.
title: Mayoral candidate's campaign manager shot dead in Himba, Tandubas, Tawi-Tawi
summary: The campaign manager of a mayoral candidate in Tandubas, Tawi-Tawi, was shot repeatedly by a lone gunman with an M16 rifle while standing in Barangay Himba, Tandubas, on Friday, February 28, 2025, and died on the spot. The gunman escaped, and the victim's relatives said the killing was politically motivated.

note: Philstar says a policewoman shot dead a fellow policewoman in Barangay Biaba Damag, Marawi, on Thursday, February 27, and was herself wounded when the victim returned fire.
summary: A policewoman was shot dead by a fellow policewoman during an argument in Barangay Biaba Damag, Marawi City, on the afternoon of Thursday, February 27, 2025; the shooter was wounded when the victim returned fire. Both were assigned to a police unit in Marawi City.

note: MB, Inquirer and SunStar confirm the vice mayor was shot and wounded in Barangay Magaslong, Datu Piang, on February 24, 2025.
BusinessMirror, MB, DZRH, ABC and others confirm the 2 p.m. February 6, 2025 crash in Barangay Malatimon, Ampatuan, that killed all 4 aboard.
Inquirer says the vice mayoral candidate's vehicle was fired on in Buluan but nobody was hurt (the driver's vest stopped the bullet), so it is not a qualifying shooting.
GMA first reported about 180 houses razed; Philstar's later BFP and CDRRMO figure is about 100 houses in the Tukananes area of Poblacion 7.
title: Fire razes about 100 houses in Poblacion 7, Cotabato City
summary: A fire on Friday, January 24, 2025, destroyed about 100 houses, most of light materials, in the Tukananes area of Barangay Poblacion 7, Cotabato City, according to the BFP and city disaster office (GMA first reported around 180). Residents said it may have started at an electric pole that caught fire; the BFP was still determining the cause, and victims were moved to evacuation sites.

note: Philstar says 3 more houses burned in Barangay Rosary Heights 10 about five hours after the Poblacion 7 fire on January 24, 2025.
MB and Rappler say 2 soldiers and 2 attackers were killed (4 dead) and 12 soldiers wounded in Barangay Lower Cabengbeng, Sumisip; nothing loaded calls the soldiers intelligence officers.
title: 4 killed, 12 soldiers wounded in Lower Cabengbeng, Sumisip ambush
summary: Two soldiers of the Army's 32nd Infantry Battalion and two attackers were killed and 12 soldiers wounded when armed men, allegedly backed by MILF fighters, ambushed troops securing a UNDP mission in Barangay Lower Cabengbeng, Sumisip, Basilan, from about 3:55 p.m. on January 22, 2025; a KM450 military truck was burned. The MILF and the military gave conflicting accounts of coordination, the MILF opened a probe, and about 135 families fled to the town hall.

note: Philstar names the place: the ambush was on the Lamitan-Sumisip Highway in Barangay Lagayas, Tipo-Tipo, on Friday, January 10, 2025.
title: Entrepreneur killed, companion wounded in Lagayas, Tipo-Tipo ambush
summary: A travelling merchant was killed and her companion wounded in the abdomen when gunmen fired pistols at their motorcycle on the Lamitan-Sumisip Highway in Barangay Lagayas, Tipo-Tipo, Basilan, on Friday, January 10, 2025, as they rode home to Isabela City from Sumisip. The gunmen fled on a motorcycle; the wounded man was taken to a hospital in Lamitan City.

note: GMA confirms the vessel had engine trouble near Pangutaran on January 8 and its 106 passengers and 15 crew were rescued 5.4 nautical miles west of Siklangkalong Island on January 14, 2025.

Inquirer says the ambush was at 4 p.m. on Saturday, December 7, 2024, on a dirt road in Barangay Paigoay, Marogong; 2 retired policemen were killed and 3, including a Malabang vice mayoral candidate, were hurt.
title: 2 killed, Malabang vice mayoral candidate among 3 hurt in Marogong ambush
summary: Two retired policemen were killed and three people were injured, among them Ramil Bao, a Malabang vice mayoral candidate, when gunmen ambushed their Toyota Innova on a dirt road in Barangay Paigoay, Marogong, Lanao del Sur, at about 4 p.m. on Saturday, December 7, 2024, as they headed to Malabang. Police were looking at rido (clan feud) as a possible motive.

note: The only source is a Philippine Star Facebook post that loaded no text.
Inquirer/PNA: rido clash on Bongo Island off Parang on Friday (reported Saturday Oct 19), 7 MILF fighters dead, no civilian casualties.
title: 7 armed men killed in clashes on Bongo Island, Parang
summary: Two armed groups locked in a rido clashed on Bongo Island off Parang, Maguindanao del Norte, on 18 October 2024, and gunmen later fired on police and Marines who responded. Seven MILF fighters were killed; no civilian casualties were reported.

note: Inquirer article blocked (403 bot page); no text to check.
Inquirer (Jul 29): lightning hit a waiting shed in front of Kayaga Elementary School, Barangay Kayaga, Pandag, on Sunday; 1 dead, 1 critically hurt.
title: Lightning kills woman, injures another in Kayaga, Pandag
summary: Lightning struck a waiting shed in front of Kayaga Elementary School in Barangay Kayaga, Pandag, Maguindanao del Sur, on 28 July 2024, where two motorbike riders were sheltering from heavy rain. One woman died and her companion was critically hurt.

note: Inquirer: van of a Kalanganan 2 village chair ambushed on Mabini Street, Barangay Bagua 3, about 8 p.m. Friday June 7; 1 of 5 wounded died next day, the chair unhurt.
summary: Gunmen ambushed a van owned by the village chair of Barangay Kalanganan 2 on Mabini Street, Barangay Bagua 3, Cotabato City, at about 8 p.m. on 7 June 2024. Five people aboard were wounded and one died the next morning; the village chair was unhurt.

note: Inquirer: police captain and the armed man he tried to disarm both died in an exchange of fire at Poblacion 2 public market, Parang, 11 a.m. Thursday May 2.
title: Police captain and gunman killed in Parang market shootout
summary: A police captain tried to disarm a man carrying a pistol at the Poblacion 2 public market in Parang, Maguindanao del Norte, at 11 a.m. on 2 May 2024. They traded shots and both died on the spot.

note: Inquirer: 4 MILF members ambushed on the highway in Barangay Satan, Shariff Aguak, past 8 a.m. Sunday April 14; rido blamed.
title: 4 MILF members killed in ambush in Satan, Shariff Aguak
summary: Gunmen on both sides of the highway ambushed four MILF members on two motorbikes in Barangay Satan, Shariff Aguak, Maguindanao del Sur, past 8 a.m. on 14 April 2024, killing all four. Police attributed the attack to a long-standing rido.

note: Inquirer: city GSO chief Pedro Tato Jr. and his driver wounded in ambush on Sebastian Street, Barangay Rosary Heights 10, Tuesday morning; the driver died.
title: Driver killed, city GSO chief hurt in Rosary Heights 10 ambush, Cotabato City
summary: Two gunmen on motorbikes fired on the pick-up of Cotabato City General Services Office chief Pedro Tato Jr. on Sebastian Street, Barangay Rosary Heights 10, at about 8:30 a.m. on a Tuesday in August 2023. His driver died in hospital and Tato was wounded.

note: Inquirer: the former Rajah Buayan vice mayor was ambushed in Barangay Pingguiaman, Lambayong, Sultan Kudarat province, outside the map.
Inquirer (both): shootout while serving warrants in Barangay Damawato, Datu Paglas, at 2 a.m. Sunday June 18; 7 gunmen killed, 1 police corporal hurt.
title: 7 alleged BIFF members killed, police officer hurt in Datu Paglas clash
summary: Police and soldiers serving arrest warrants in Barangay Damawato, Datu Paglas, Maguindanao del Sur, were fired on at about 2 a.m. on 18 June 2023, sparking a two-hour firefight. Seven alleged BIFF members were killed and a police corporal was wounded.

note: Only article is a PNA link returning 404 with no text.
Cebu Daily News/Inquirer: nurse killed, husband critically hurt in ambush on a dirt road of Barangay Ungap, Sultan Kudarat, past 8 p.m. Friday May 26.
title: Government nurse slain, husband hurt in ambush in Ungap, Sultan Kudarat
summary: Gunmen ambushed a couple's vehicle on a dimly lit road in Barangay Ungap, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, past 8 p.m. on 26 May 2023 during a heavy downpour. A government nurse died on the spot and her husband was critically wounded.

note: Inquirer: 11 Malaysians on a speedboat with engine failure rescued drifting in Sibutu Passage on Friday March 31; Coast Guard Sibutu and MDRRMO Sibutu assisted.
title: 11 Malaysians rescued from drifting speedboat in Sibutu Passage
summary: A Malaysian family speedboat whose engine failed drifted into Sibutu Passage, Tawi-Tawi, and its 11 passengers were rescued on 31 March 2023. The Coast Guard and Sibutu disaster office gave them food, water and medical aid before they were turned over to the Royal Malaysian Navy.

note: Inquirer: BIFF member linked to SAF 44 killed resisting arrest in Datu Saudi Ampatuan about noon on a Friday; article date not in text, so day left unset.
title: Gunman linked to SAF 44 deaths killed in Datu Saudi Ampatuan operation
summary: A BIFF member linked to the 2015 killing of 44 SAF officers opened fire on police and Army operatives serving his arrest warrant in Datu Saudi Ampatuan, Maguindanao del Sur, at about noon on a Friday in April 2023, and was killed.

note: Inquirer: Magelco department manager ambushed on the diversion road in Barangay Upper Capiton, Datu Odin Sinsuat, past 1 p.m. Wednesday April 19.
title: Magelco executive slain in ambush in Upper Capiton, Datu Odin Sinsuat
summary: Gunmen ambushed a department manager of the Maguindanao Electric Cooperative as he drove alone on the diversion road in Barangay Upper Capiton, Datu Odin Sinsuat, past 1 p.m. on 19 April 2023. He was killed and his car hit a tree.

note: Inquirer: motor banca sank near Pandak Island, Hadji Muhtamad, on Tuesday February 28; 6 rescued.
Inquirer: police staff sergeant killed, corporal wounded in ambush in Barangay Uban-Uban, Picong, on the Saturday a week after the Feb 4 Marogong ambush.
title: Police sergeant killed, corporal wounded in ambush in Uban-Uban, Picong
summary: Suspected car thieves ambushed two police officers of the 2nd Lanao del Sur Police Mobile Force Company in Barangay Uban-Uban, Picong, on 11 February 2023 as they returned from recovering a stolen vehicle. A staff sergeant was killed and a corporal was wounded.

note: Inquirer: two Scout Rangers on a motorcycle ambushed in Barangay Cabengbeng, Sumisip, about 8:55 a.m. on a Tuesday; 1 dead, 1 wounded (article date not in text).
title: Scout Ranger killed, another wounded in ambush in Cabengbeng, Sumisip
summary: Gunmen riding in tandem fired on two Scout Rangers on a motorcycle in Barangay Cabengbeng, Sumisip, Basilan, at about 8:55 a.m. on a Tuesday in February 2023. One soldier died on the spot and the other was taken to Lamitan District Hospital.

note: Inquirer: a Pikit village councilman was shot from behind in front of the Al Nor Convention Center on Sinsuat Avenue, Cotabato City, at 6:10 p.m. on a Friday, the eve of his wedding.
title: Pikit village councilman shot dead on Sinsuat Avenue, Cotabato City
summary: A village councilman of Pikit, Cotabato province, was shot from behind at about 6:10 p.m. on a Friday in January 2023 in front of the Al Nor Convention Center on Sinsuat Avenue, Cotabato City, while preparing for his wedding the next day. He was dead on arrival at hospital.

note: Inquirer: off-duty Marine sergeant shot in his parked car on Moreno Drive, Barangay Rosary Heights 2, on a Sunday (article date not in text).
title: Marine sergeant shot dead in Rosary Heights 2, Cotabato City
summary: Two men on a motorbike shot an off-duty Marine sergeant as he sat in his parked car on Moreno Drive, Barangay Rosary Heights 2, Cotabato City, on a Sunday in December 2022. He died of wounds to the head and body.

note: Inquirer: the attack was at the public market of Lutayan, Sultan Kudarat province (Lutayan police, Sultan Kudarat provincial police), not Sultan Kudarat town in Maguindanao del Norte; outside the map.
Inquirer: Army officer's car ambushed on Sinsuat Avenue at 7:20 p.m. Saturday, a day after a Nov 11 killing; driver killed, officer unharmed.
title: Army officer survives ambush on Sinsuat Avenue, Cotabato City; driver killed
summary: Two gunmen fired on an Army officer's car along Sinsuat Avenue near Cotabato City Hall at 7:20 p.m. on 12 November 2022. The officer was unharmed but his driver, an Army corporal, died.

note: Inquirer: gunmen strafed a family's house in Guiong village, Sumisip, about 1:30 a.m. Thursday September 8; 2 dead, 4 children hurt.
title: 2 dead, 4 children hurt in strafing in Guiong, Sumisip
summary: Gunmen strafed a family's house in Barangay Guiong, Sumisip, Basilan, at about 1:30 a.m. on 8 September 2022 while the family slept. Two adults died and four children were wounded.

note: Inquirer: Marine patrol attacked in Barangay Punong, Picong, about 6 p.m. on a Sunday; 3 Marines wounded in feet and legs (article date not in text).
title: 3 Marines wounded in ambush in Punong, Picong
summary: An armed group attacked a Marine patrol truck in Barangay Punong, Picong, Lanao del Sur, at about 6 p.m. on a Sunday in September 2022. Three Marines were wounded in the feet and legs.

note: Inquirer: defeated UBJP mayoral candidate Datu Jamael Sinsuat shot dead leaving a mosque in Barangay Dalican, Datu Odin Sinsuat, about 12:30 p.m. on a Friday.
title: Defeated mayoral candidate shot dead after prayer in Dalican, Datu Odin Sinsuat
summary: Gunmen shot dead Datu Jamael Sinsuat, a former Dalican village chair and defeated mayoral candidate, as he left a mosque in Barangay Dalican, Datu Odin Sinsuat, at about 12:30 p.m. on a Friday in September 2022. He was dead on arrival at the district hospital.

note: MindaNews article blocked (bot page); no text to check.
Inquirer: encounter at Sitio Bato Maputi, Barangay Baguindan, Tipo-Tipo, Saturday June 25; 3 Abu Sayyaf killed, 9 wounded including 3 soldiers.
title: 3 suspected Abu Sayyaf killed, 9 hurt in clash in Baguindan, Tipo-Tipo
summary: Troops tracking an Abu Sayyaf sub-leader clashed with his group at Sitio Bato Maputi, Barangay Baguindan, Tipo-Tipo, Basilan, on 25 June 2022. Three suspected Abu Sayyaf members were killed and nine people were wounded, three of them soldiers.

note: Inquirer: supporters of rival candidates traded shots inside Malabang National High School, Malabang, shortly before noon Monday (election day); 3 dead, 2 hurt.
title: 3 dead, 2 hurt in shootout inside Malabang voting center
summary: Supporters of rival local candidates traded shots inside the voting center at Malabang National High School, Malabang, Lanao del Sur, shortly before noon on election day, 9 May 2022. Three voters were killed and two were wounded.

note: Only article is a PNA link returning 404 with no text.
The only article (PNA 1157912) returned a 404 page with no text.
Inquirer: 2 students shot dead inside the MSU campus in Barangay Cadayonan II, Marawi, past 6 pm on Tuesday, Sept. 14.
summary: 2 Mindanao State University students were shot dead by 2 men on a motorcycle inside the MSU campus in Barangay Cadayonan II, Marawi City, past 6 pm on 14 September 2021, as they walked to their dormitory.

note: Inquirer: a wounded MSU-Maguindanao professor returned fire and killed both motorcycle-riding attackers on the national highway in Datu Odin Sinsuat on a Tuesday; article date not in shard, so day left unset.
title: Professor ambushed in Datu Odin Sinsuat survives; 2 attackers killed
